query: The Wandering Section The section the book belongs to wanders. It was by the stairs on Monday and in the map room on Wednesday. The only way to follow it is to tie a string to the end shelf and walk where it goes, however long that takes. Follow it with string You follow it for six hours, through rooms you didn't know the library had. At the end you know its route by heart and never want to see a ball of string again. Wait for it to come back You read at the desk until the section wanders past again, a day later. You learn nothing about its route, and a little about medieval ward-lattices.
